title: Lesson 7 - Could You Keep It Down?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Hi, Aisha. I'm sorry to bother you, but could you keep the music down a little?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Oh, sure. Is it coming through the wall?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes. The bass is pretty strong in my living room. I'm recording a short presentation for work around nine.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't realize it was that loud. I'm checking the sound for an animation, and I put the speaker right against this wall.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That explains it. Would you mind moving the speaker to the other side of the room?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Not at all. I can put it on my desk. Could I play it quietly for another twenty minutes? I need to check two more sections.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That should work. Is there any chance you could use headphones after nine?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yes. I have a wired pair somewhere. Let me make sure I've got this right: low volume until nine, then headphones.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Exactly. And I'll message you if I can still hear it.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I moved the speaker earlier, and I'm using headphones now. Can you still hear anything?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: No, it's quiet now. Thanks for sticking to the plan.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Of course. I didn't want to make it harder for you to record.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: The recording is about to start, so the timing is perfect. Thanks, Aisha.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: You're welcome. Good luck with your presentation.
